The nightly job now counts a retried payment once, and the fix is committed as `55de233` on `main`.

The cause was in `src/orders-service-v1/nightly_job.py`: it counted payment rows that matched no order, so a bank retry with the same payment id was counted once per row. It now collects the unmatched payment ids into a set and returns its size.

I added a regression test to `tests/test_orders_service_v1.py` with two rows sharing one id, expecting a count of 1. Both tests in that file pass.

I left the existing uncommitted `README.md` change and the untracked `notes/` directory out of the commit, since they aren't part of this fix.
